title-greeting: Welcome to Lost Pet Hero! Pets in Wildwood need your help. Are you ready to bring them home?
tutor-hero: This is your hero. Tap Continue when you are ready.
tutor-hero-easy: This is your hero. You can tap a different picture first. Then tap Continue.
tutor-job: Pebble is lost. Tap Pebble's card.
tutor-job-easy: Pebble is lost. Tap the card with Pebble's picture.
tutor-walk-easy: Tap the glowing tile. It is the bright circle on the path.
tutor-clue-easy: A picture clue! The picture shows paws. Tap OK.
tutor-calm: Tap a snack. Then tap when the star is in the green.
tutor-calm-easy: Tap any snack. The green zone is big. Then tap the button.
tutor-home-easy: Walk Pebble south to the little house.
reunion-pebble: You did it! Pebble is home!
mode-choose: How do you want to play? Pick Easy or Normal!
mode-easy: Easy mode! I'll give you lots of help.
mode-normal: Normal mode! You're a brave explorer!
jobboard-intro: This is the Emberhollow job board. Pick a pet to help!
job-pip: Nana Moss misses Pip the kitten! Can you find her?
job-bramble: Coach Wren's puppy, Bramble, ran into the woods! Let's go!
job-luma: Luma the owl flew away! Keeper Sol needs you!
calm-start: Shh... the pet is scared. Let's help it feel safe.
calm-success: You did it! It trusts you!
reunion-cheer: Hooray! They're together again! You're a Lost Pet Hero!
reunion-pip: You did it! Pip is home!
reunion-bramble: You did it! Bramble is home!
reunion-luma: You did it! Luma is home!
reunion-thanks: Thank you for bringing them home!
sanctuary-new: A new friend joined your sanctuary!
grownups-gate: Grown-ups only! Ask a grown-up to help.
come-back: Come back soon! More pets need you!
